plan: A scarecrow jungler who bursts out of a bush and terrifies a whole team with his crows.
aSurveiller: His R (Crowstorm). He teleports into the middle of you and damages everything around him: spread out and hit him.
contrer: Spread out when he arrives: his R damages everyone around him.
His effigies look like him: be wary of a motionless Fiddlesticks in a bush.
Interrupt his W with crowd control: he has to channel it.
forces: His R starts fights from far away.

sorts.W: Drains the health of nearby enemies.
sorts.E: Scythe swing that slows and silences.
sorts.R: Teleports and unleashes crows around him.

momentFort: His most important spike is level 6, with his R: he tries to reach it as fast as possible.
